nodes.body_md: The token store keeps per-client counters in Redis for low-latency reads.[^clm_5e3fe6f8db369532]
Rejected requests return a 429 status with a Retry-After header.[^clm_a1afd01dbc173d1d]
Clients authenticate with an API key passed in the Authorization header.[^clm_36cfb9f6ac6d72c5]
The /v1/limits endpoint returns the current quota for the authenticated client.[^clm_2dba27d146934f6a]
The Gateway service returns HTTP 429 when a client exceeds its quota.[^clm_10d2571671858b9b]
List endpoints return at most fifty items per page.[^clm_4456aebfa2e7a0be]
Alerts fire when the rejection rate exceeds five percent.[^clm_bb92b1744d8314f4]
Redis was chosen as the counter store for its atomic increment operations.[^clm_0e46ae81bdf5fa3c]

RateGuard uses a token-bucket algorithm.[^clm_ac4503e287c856ef] The default rate limit is 100 requests per second[^clm_20e5846f3d00bec6], though the team agreed to raise it to 1000 requests per second.[^clm_ba0a11995afc89d8]
It remains undecided how to handle clients that share an IP address.[^clm_cd88de4eb8add55a]
